facts.fact: a new Subdivision Surface modifier: levels 1 (viewport), render_levels 2, Catmull-Clark, quality 3
Catmull-Clark on a size-2 cube: faces x4 per level (6, 24, 96, 384, 1536); with use_limit_surface on, x_max is 0.8395 at every level 1-4 (vertices sit on the limit surface)
SIMPLE subdivision keeps the cube's shape (x_max stays 1)
with crease_edge = 1.0 on every edge, Catmull-Clark keeps the cube's corners (x_max back to 1)
a new Array modifier: count 2, fit_type FIXED_COUNT, relative offset (1,0,0), merge off
Array count 5 with relative offset 1: copies touch, 5x the verts (no merge)
with use_merge_vertices, touching copies share their faces' vertices
constant offset 3 on a size-2 cube leaves gaps of 1
fit_type FIT_LENGTH 20 with constant offset 3 picks the count that fits
a new Mirror modifier mirrors X across the object's origin, merge on (0.001), clipping off
mirroring a cube that touches the plane at x=0 merges the seam vertices (16 -> 12)
with use_mirror_merge off, the seam keeps duplicate vertices
a mesh crossing the mirror plane overlaps its mirror copy unless use_bisect_axis is on
on a mesh spanning x -0.5..1.5, use_bisect_axis[0] keeps the NEGATIVE side and mirrors it (x -0.5..0.5); use_bisect_flip_axis[0] keeps the positive side instead (x -1.5..1.5)
